description: The Dutch Cultural Heritage Agency (RCE) publishes its authoritative register of cultural heritage objects as linked open data. The CHO dataset holds national monuments (rijksmonumenten), world heritage, protected town and village views, archaeological sites, finds and investigations, about 59 million statements modelled in the Cultural Heritage Ontology, updated continuously with daily difference graphs in a separate dataset. A subset of the national monuments modelled in Schema.org is released under CC0. The public Rijksmonumentenregister search lets users find monuments by number, complex, address, postcode, name or description and filter by province and municipality; its province facets summed to about 63,000 monuments when read. Coverage: the Netherlands. Access: TriplyDB datasets with SPARQL queries and downloads, and the register search site. Licence: CC BY 4.0 for the CHO data unless stated otherwise, CC0 for the Schema.org subset; free. Caveats: the CHO dataset holds only the current state, and building footprints come from other registers such as BAG. Simulation uses are heritage exposure and constraint layers for flood, subsidence and retrofit planning. Related records: the BAG register and the French Mérimée monument list.
